Rhetta has completed 9 marathons in her life, remarkably going from 3h15 to 2h59 in only 1 year. We talk with her about her journey to sub 3h, her motivation to take on this challenge, her training regimen, and about the lovely running community she has found for herself in LA with Good Vibes Track Club.
